response.sql: WITH c AS (SELECT ci.location AS city, COUNT(*) AS qualifying_count FROM qualifying q JOIN races r ON q.raceId = r.raceId JOIN circuits ci ON r.circuitId = ci.circuitId GROUP BY ci.location), s AS (SELECT city, qualifying_count, qualifying_count * 1.0 / SUM(qualifying_count) OVER () AS share FROM c), a AS (SELECT city, qualifying_count, share, AVG(share) OVER () AS avg_share FROM s) SELECT city, qualifying_count, share, share - avg_share AS share_above_average FROM a WHERE share > avg_share ORDER BY share DESC
